rules: Every physical page must occur exactly once in page registry, including cover/TOC/exercises/image-only/colophon.
Paragraph/region extraction is not a knowledge atom and a page link is not semantic coverage.
Each unit has exact source hash/page/bbox or explicit unresolved locator; mapping distinguishes exact reviewed evidence from candidates.
No source prose/table/image/PDF payload is copied to repository or learner assets.
No non-empty mappings or structural tests imply 100 percent knowledge closure.
All answer options must be included; true-false questions retain two options rather than fabricated distractors.
New original calculations require sufficient explicit data and valid units; not inferred from unspecified source parameters.
Excluded source items require explicit reason; repeated concepts keep source occurrence provenance.
Only root writes common matrix, summaries and runtime fixes; agents write owned directories.

acceptance.sourceInventory: all574pages classified with page content receipts
acceptance.criticalKnowledge: every audited critical unit taught or explained with reviewed exact binding
acceptance.unusedKnowledge: explicit pedagogic/scope/source reason for each excluded unit
acceptance.traceability: every technical learnerclaim has a verified supporting source at appropriate granularity
acceptance.assessment: all keys/distractors/rationales semantically checked against taught knowledge
acceptance.translations: 12locale field coverage and actual semantic review
acceptance.images: source/model comparison, legible geometry and no pre-submit disclosure
acceptance.technical: automated tests and actual physical-device results
acceptance.signoff: separate real expert and native approval
